featured_reviews.review_text:
FRAUD ALERT – PETROL PUMP CHEATING AT MANICKPUR, VASAI

People are already stressed about fuel issues, but what happened to me at a petrol pump in Vasai is beyond unacceptable — it’s outright cheating.

On 28 March at around 11:03 PM, we were returning home from the doctor, and I was not keeping well. On the way, my husband’s bike ran out of petrol, and we still had around 6 km to go. With no option left, we stood in a long queue at a petrol pump in Manickpur. After a long wait, when our turn finally came, we decided to fill the tank full using auto-cut — just to avoid going through this hassle again, especially since I wasn’t well. The auto-cut stopped at around ₹700 (~7 litres).

Then the attendant casually asked, “Upar tak bhar doon?” We said bhar do.

And that’s where the scam begins. Without any clarity or reset, the meter was pushed straight to ₹1400. There was a huge rush, I wasn’t well, our child was home alone, and we were already getting late — so we paid and left. But later, when we actually thought about it, the numbers didn’t make sense:

₹1400 petrol ≈ 13.5 litres
Bike: 135cc Pulsar → Tank capacity ≈ 8 litres

So the question is simple:

How does 13+ litres fit into an 8-litre tank?

This is not a mistake. This is not confusion. This is fraud. At a time when common people are already dealing with rising fuel costs and anxiety, such petrol pumps are openly looting customers under pressure situations.

This is a direct complaint against the Bharat Petroleum petrol pump at Manickpur, Vasai.

I have full transaction proof (dated 28 March, 11:03 PM) and am ready to escalate this to higher authorities, consumer forums, and oil company officials.

I demand: Immediate inspection of the pump and meter calibration CCTV verification of the incident Strict action against the staff involved

People need to stay alert. Because this is not just my story — this can happen to anyone

featured_reviews.name: ANUJ PANDEY
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the good fortune of visiting a petrol pump recently that was excellent by every parameter—service, hygiene, and overall customer experience. On a high-density highway stretch, this fuel pump is a daily commuter's and long-distance traveler's savior. My experience was truly eye-opening, and here is an in-depth review on multiple parameters:

Location & Accessibility:
The petrol pump is well-placed on the highway, easily accessible to all vehicles—two-wheelers, four-wheelers, and even big trucks. There is sufficient space to drive in, out, and about without much bother, even at busy times of the day. Signboards guiding you to the pump are well-marked from afar so you won't miss the turn.

Fuel Quality & Availability:
Fuel quality is perhaps the most important aspect of any petrol outlet, and this filling station does not disappoint in that area. Both petrol and diesel are provided on a regular basis, and they also provide premium fuel variants such as XP95 and Power diesel. I observed a fuel quality checking board with daily calibration reports, which instils confidence in their product. My experience was enhanced engine performance and mileage, which shows clean and contamination-free fuel.

Staff & Service:
Staff here are polite, well-dressed in their uniforms, and professionally courteous. They welcomed me with a smile, politely inquired about the fuel needed, and even cleaned the windshield and checked the air pressure for free. Billing was hassle-free—cash and digital payments (UPI, cards, wallets) were accepted, and an instant-printed receipt was handed over. The attendants did not insist on additional services, which made the experience genuine and respectful.

Cleanliness & Amenities:
What actually impressed me was the premises' cleanliness. The premises were free from litter, the ground was not oily with oil spills, and the restrooms were surprisingly clean. A small convenience store was annexed, with snacks, cold beverages, basic car accessories, and travel necessities. There's also an RO water dispenser, which is a godsend on long trips.

Other Facilities:
The air-filling point was in good working condition and could be used for free, complete with tyre pressure and nitrogen top-up. There is also a dedicated lane for commercial trucks and a small service bay for simple vehicle checkups such as oil top-off and battery tests. CCTV cameras were placed throughout the grounds, providing extra security and transparency.

Weaknesses:
One thing I would criticize, if I must, is the limited seating area. For tourists who simply wish to take a brief respite, a shaded sitting area would have been perfect. And at times of peak traffic, the line tends to accumulate, and even if staff attempt to control it efficiently, it takes a little longer than anticipated.

Final Verdict:
Overall, this petrol pump is a highly recommended stop for anyone seeking quick refueling, courteous service, and clean surroundings. It reflects professionalism and customer care, which makes it stand out among many others. I’ll definitely be returning here for my future refueling needs.

Other than this when you ask if they are having pine lab card machines, they would agree and then after filling cng they will swipe your card on paytm machines which will occur 1% surcharge and we will lose our cashback.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Jha
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice and clean toilets and fuel is available 24/7

featured_reviews.name: Allwyn D'souza
featured_reviews.review_text: Cheating while filling petrol especially when they have some offer on UPI payments. Also the guy who helps in filling air in the tyres will ensure you end up getting your tyres repaired showing puncture in the tyres.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Shrivastava
featured_reviews.review_text:
Supportive Staff..

Little bit crowded during peak hours.. if you want to take CNG please prefer non peak hours...

Drinking water and Washroom facility available here.

All type of payment option accepted here (Cash/Card/UPI).

Lubricants / Engine oil can be purchased here for your bike/car.

featured_reviews.name: Shalem
featured_reviews.review_text:
Online CNG pump near Mira road.
The pump is operational for 24hours.
The attendants are good and cooperative.
No long queues.
Accepts payments via cash and cards.

There is one more pump on the other side od the road with the HP petrol pump.

The pressure was between 180-200 when I visited this pump a few times.

featured_reviews.name: Romel Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
Something is not right at this Petrol Pump, I filled CNG and my tap was used (unknowingly) and then my card was used where I put pin.

As I left I checked the SMS 2 times had come.

I went to meet the owner and he was very casual about my complaint. I got my refund but this practice is happening on purpose.

This is the 2nd time it has happened.

Beware.
